strategy_statement: CS2 (and some Dota 2) in-play bot; from 10-16 a buy-only two-sided maker plus an informed taker, before that a round-trip taker in GRID tier-1/2 events. [VALIDATE-only] Selection: whole events (match + all maps) of non-GRID tier-3 leagues (1win, Stake, PGL, Circuit X, DraculaN, NODWIN, ...; since 10-31 also CyberClash and FiReSPORTS), never an event with a GRID official-data series id (0/122), favouring popular events, and always events the informed pack also trades in play (100% of traded vs 50% of skipped non-GRID events); event rule AUC 0.954 vs activity 0.892. These are exactly the events in which Polymarket's own sports feed carries no round scores. [VALIDATE-only] Maker: from game start it keeps whole-cent BUY orders near the best bid on BOTH outcome tokens (100 shares in CS2, 10 in Dota 2), never sells, merges complete pairs (97% paired, pair cost 0.978) and holds the residual; at its own takes it cancels its 100-share complement bids within 13-16 ms (the earliest cancels of the wave are its own) and re-quotes them 3-8c lower about 1.04 s later (as soon as its FAK returns from the in-play delay) and the slower informed takers fill them, so it sells the bought team back to them and locks pairs at 0.96-0.99. [hypothesis, live dev block] Taker: on in-round game events it sends FAK BUYs of the team that gained (in map and match markets within 1-4 ms) at the pre-event best ask + 0-5c, sized about 0.3x the pre-event depth; on the CLOB server clock it signs before every public trace and is the first same-team signer in 90% of cases: its own complement cancels come first (+13-16 ms), other makers' cancels of that team's asks follow at +17 / +67 / +124 ms (p10 / p25 / p50), so the fastest of them act on the same external event within tens of ms, the informed pack signs 0.2-0.5 s later, and its order matches 1.04 s after signing (the in-play delay) against makers who did not cancel. Its input is a private in-round feed that none of the obtained public data contains; the iteration-2 'book-collapse trigger' was a receive-clock artefact and is retracted. [VALIDATE-only] Economics: locked pair margins and rebates plus the informed taker legs; a generic public-data ladder in the same markets loses 5-10%.

selection.description: Whole events of non-GRID CS2 leagues (never a GRID event: 0/122), a subset of the events the informed pack covers (pack in play in 100% of traded vs 50% of skipped non-GRID events); event logistic (league rate with GRID zeroing + pre-game popularity) AUC 0.954 vs activity 0.892 (gain +0.062, p 0.002), recall 0.72 at lift 3.3; bo3 stars add nothing.

timing.description: Maker: quotes from game start; at its own taker signal it cancels its 100-share complement bids within 13-16 ms and re-posts them ~1.04 s later, when its FAK returns (VALIDATE-only for the re-post, live for the cancel). Taker: at in-round game events seen on an unobserved private feed; on the server clock it signs before every public trace (first same-team signer in 90%); fan-out legs in map + match within 1-4 ms (hypothesis for the input).

side.description: Maker: both outcomes (VALIDATE-only). Taker: the team that just gained in-round (the team whose asks other makers pull right after it signs; +2.6-2.9c in 10 s).

price.description: Maker: whole-cent BUYs near the best bid (server clock: 29% at the bid, 55% within 1c; in-play tick 0.01; last-print anchor 0.305). Taker: FAK limit at the pre-event best ask + 0-5c (0c 26%, +1c 22%, +2-3c 29%, +4-5c 21%; server-clock book 50 ms before signing).

size.description: Maker 100 shares in CS2 markets, 10 in Dota 2 (all 10-share orders are Dota 2). Taker: about 0.31x of the pre-event depth up to its limit (server clock); the cancel wave removes 82% of that depth and it fills ~98% of what is left; exact 1000/2000 caps fading (14% VALIDATE, 0% on 10-31).

exit.description: Never sells; at its own takes it pulls its complement ladder at once and re-posts it 3-8c lower ~1.04 s later, which the slower informed takers fill (pair cost 0.96-0.99); merges complete pairs; holds the unpaired residual to resolution.

Acted vs non-acted comparison moot (the waves follow its own decision); per-league presence of 0x2e3c40fa as a selection feature not tested (canceller_id.json).

X35.evidence: assumptions panel P6 (iter 2): versions. All 10-share maker orders are Dota 2 (10-22 and dev block), so the 10-22 'version' was the game mix; CS2 maker 100 shares 89.4% (16-22 Oct) vs 78.4% (dev); taker caps 1000/2000 14.4% vs 0%, size median 470 vs 183, fill frac 0.155 vs 0.242: taker sizing drifts, maker rule stable (versions_price.json).

X36.evidence: own direction (iter 3): HLTV scorebot as a public in-round CS2 feed. GET https://scorebot-lb.hltv.org/socket.io/?EIO=3&transport=polling -> 403 Cloudflare challenge ('Just a moment...'); scorebot-secure.hltv.org -> connect timeout; www.hltv.org/matches -> 403 Cloudflare (bot challenges are not bypassed). Used instead: Polymarket sports socket (map scores only for its events) and bo3.gg (no live coverage).
